notes.title: Free Camera Mode Alpha
notes.content:
Per request, we’ve added in a basic Free Camera Mode to Wave Break that will allow players to capture custom footage. As it is still very basic and rudimentary, we will look into making improvements based on feedback from our community as we move forward.

[h1]How to Access Free Camera Mode[/h1]
[h2]Entering Chat[/h2]
[olist]
[*] Boot the game.
[*] Select and start any game mode.
[*] Once in the game mode, press ‘Enter’ on the keyboard to access Chat.
[*] Once in Chat, you can type in specific commands.
[/olist]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34089288/4ac980db57525f3fdf62b4e45f745e8d3f29c8fa.jpg[/img]
[h1]Basic Commands[/h1]
[h2]Turn Off UI[/h2]
[olist]
[*] Access Chat in game.
[*] In Chat, type in: [b]/toggle_ui
[/b][*] To turn UI back on, press ‘Enter’ to access Chat, then type in: [b]/toggle_ui[/b]
[/olist]
[h2]Spectator Mode[/h2]
[olist]
[*] Access Chat in game.
[*] In Chat, type in: [b]/toggle_spectate[/b]; if done correctly, you’ll spawn as Bigpin (the bear)
[*] Pause the game and select ‘End Run.’
[*] Start the game again; you will now start in free cam, and can move the camera using the left analog stick, and pan the camera with the right analog stick.
[*] To turn off Spectator Mode, press ‘Enter’ to access Chat, then type in: [b]/toggle_spectate[/b]
[/olist]
[h2]Freeze Camera Position[/h2]
[olist]
[*] Access Chat in game
[*] In Chat, type in: [b]/freeze_camera_position[/b]; if done correctly, the camera will now be in the fixed position, and will remain that position until it is disabled.
[*] To turn off Freeze Camera Position, press ‘Enter’ to access Chat, then type in: [b]/freeze_camera_position[/b]
[/olist]
[h2]Freeze Camera Rotation[/h2]
[olist]
[*] Access Chat in game.
[*] In Chat, type in: [b]/freeze_camera_rotation[/b]; if done correctly, you will be unable to change the camera rotation/panning.
[*] To turn off Freeze Camera Rotation, press ‘Enter’ to access Chat, then type in: [b]/freeze_camera_rotation[/b]
[/olist]
[h1]Multiple Displays[/h1]
[olist]
[*] If you have a multiple display setup, first go to the ‘Options’ Menu, and on the first tab for ‘Graphics,’ select ‘Multiple Display Splitscreen.’
[*] In the Main Menu, have a second player join in (local co-op).
[*] Start any game mode, then access Chat.
[*] You’ll find that Display 1 or Player 1 will be able to input commands into the Chat, and it will directly affect Display 2 or Player 2; you can use Player 2 as a means to capture the specific footage you like, with Player 1 accessing the commands.
[/olist]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34089288/c3795646886b100a265b463cdfad529f55cec501.jpg[/img]

We'd appreciate any feedback with this new feature, and additionally, if you encounter any issues or bugs, please feel free to join our Discord and let us know!
[url=Discord.gg/FunktronicLabs][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34089288/1385557c7916d7f3ecb704e119168264fe4303e3.png[/img][/url]

notes.title: Major Update | Steam Deck Verified, New Character, Cosmetics & Event!
notes.content:
[h2]Hey Everyone![/h2]

[h3]First off, Wave Break is officially Steam Deck Verified! [/h3]

The Steam Deck is now officially supported with a native Linux build! (Some UI will be automatically scaled up for the smaller screen) 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34089288/8fc5157f61f75fb60f037a4e57de606976924ce5.png[/img]

[h3]But that's not all...remember the flamingo from the launch trailer?[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34089288/7e80167654ca94a37f871558896b496256590931.gif[/img]

[h3]We've added her in as a playable character![/h3] 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34089288/a8f6a7c392fbfdcaf6c3ce83060ec592c497eac8.png[/img]
[h3]Here are the additional changes we've made to the game:[/h3]
[list]
[*]Added new cosmetic items!
[*]Changed the menu text for "Online Lobbies" to "Custom Games" to make it more clear.
[*]Fix for semi transparent Park Creator previews for non stroke items on Vulkan.
[*]Made the first COMBO mission in the game a bit easier to complete on the initial lower stats.
[*]Updated internal Steamworks.NET
[*]The Tutorial now requests that you do some of the steps 3 times, in an effort to help people remember the controls better.
[*]The Tutorial now has an additional step of completing a single 1,000 point combo.
[*]Lowered the Campaign "Next Level" requirement from 60% to 30%.
[*]The initial stats on Big Pin have been upped by 2 or 3 per stat (mostly Grind and Automatic balance).
[*]Rescheduled all events to end at midnight PST instead of UTC.
[*]Events now show the final results the second the event is over, instead of the following day.
[/list]
[h3]Don't forget, 🎧HEADPHONES🎧 vs. 🔊SPEAKERS🔊 starts today![/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34089288/21d5c8b340770cd3085656c066be850c7f49ba69.gif[/img]

Test your skills in this month's in-game event! Play a round of Time Attack on the special event level, for a chance to win some sweet prizes! For more information, [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/761010/view/3173359579462955773]visit our previous Steam post for more details[/url]!

[url=https://discord.gg/funktroniclabs][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34089288/1385557c7916d7f3ecb704e119168264fe4303e3.png[/img][/url]

As usual, you can always find us on [url=discord.gg/funktroniclabs]Discord[/url] if you have any questions, suggestions, or just are looking for others to play the game with.

[h3]Good luck to everyone participating in the event!  See you out there![/h3]
~Funktronic Labs Dev Team

notes.title: Major Update | Signal Tools, Teams, New Cosmetics
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34089288/0f40366a2ab6868b8757e20a76f17a7e56cd1a30.png[/img]
We’re prioritizing fixes and adding features based on fan feedback, and we thank all of you who have been active on our Discord for helping to pave the way for these updates. This update will serve as a foundation for future upcoming updates, where we are introducing Team Based Game Modes, a new Signaling System, 18 new cosmetic items, new Park Creator pieces, and general quality of life bug fixes and optimization.

[h3]
Team Based Game Modes[/h3]

With Team Based Game Modes, players will now be able to team up with their friends and other SkateBOATERS in 4 vs 4 matches in Time Attack and Deathmatch. In Team Time Attack, the total overall score from each team member will be tabulated, and the team with the highest score will win the match.  For Team Deathmatch, the team with the most kills will win the match.

Team based game modes allow for some interesting strategies not available in regular competitive multiplayer.  For example, players who are more adept to the tricking mechanic can focus on raising the overall score in Team Time Attack, while other team members concentrate on disrupting the opponents trick combos by shooting at them.  


[h3]The Signaling System 
[/h3]

Brand new to the Park Creator, which will allow for deeper customization, more complex level designs, and different gameplay elements, is the Signaling System. If you’re familiar with WireMod, or Redstone in Minecraft, these features will be easy to pick up and implement. You can find out more about the Signaling System in detail in our Signal System Post we posted up earlier this week. 

https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/761010/view/2939150188529175921


[h3]New Park Creator Pieces[/h3]

Below are some new Park Creator pieces we’ve added into the game; most of these pieces pertain the to Signaling System we’ve newly created:
[list]
[*] Signal Sources: pulse, alternators, constants, randoms
[*] Signal Wires
[*] Signal Triggers: laser tripwire, button, lever, damage target, physics trigger (player only), physics trigger (anything)
[*] Logic Gates: AND, OR, NAND, XOR, NOT, DELAY, EXTEND, BUFFER, SWITCH, PULSE
[*] Dynamic Park Piece markers: enabler, movers
[*] Pickups: chickens, hotdogs
[*] Custom game functions: +1 point to nearest player, end run
[*] Prop Spawners: beach balls, buoys, chairs, trash cans
[*] Particle Spawners
[*] Death Zones
[*] Lights
[*] Speakers
[*] Teleporters
[*] Jump Pads
[/list]

[h3]
New Cosmetics Added into the Loot Pool[/h3]

We’ve added 18 new cosmetic items that can be acquired in-game at Big Beavy’s Boats and Beach Boutique shops to customize your character when taking on other skateBOATERS.


[h3]Upcoming Updates[/h3]

We have two more major updates this year, and our hope is to have a roadmap prepared by the next update that will show what you can look forward to in the upcoming months. 

[url=discord.gg/FunktronicLabs]Please keep sharing your feed back here, and in discord!  [/url]
Without you, we wouldn't have been able to do any of these things!

See you soon!

-Kyle

notes.title: Wave Break Major Update: The Signal System
notes.content:
In this upcoming update, we will be introducing the Signal System into the Park Creator game mode.
These tools will allow for deeper customization, more complex level designs, and you can even add your own game play element!

[h3][b]Essentially, we're making the buttons work, and we're letting YOU choose what to do with them![/b][/h3]


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34089288/d822006f05b82d41e977bf40c8ded0317a0ebd30.gif[/img]

If you're familiar with WireMod (Garry's Mod) or Minecraft's RedStone, these tools will be easy for you to pick up and use!



The DEV preview we put out has a high level overview of the tools added, but for now, here's a quick overview of the new tools.


[h2]The Signal Tools[/h2]

[list]
[*] [b]Source Blocks [/b]- Signal Source Blocks create a signal. Timers, pulses, constants are blocks that will send a signal in a variety of ways. 

[*] [b]Wires[/b] - Used to transfer signals. 
[i][b]note: We've added the ability to wire up MOST park pieces that were already part of the park creator...try  it out with some explosives or speed boost decals![/b][/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34089288/631535fb76ff1ce7524b60643172791cf30e7d5a.gif[/img]

[*] [b]Logic Gates[/b] - Logic Blocks allow you to alter the signal being sent before it reaches its target. Logic Blocks take two inputs and have an output depending on the state of the inputs. Logic Blocks touching other Logic Blocks do not need a wire.  

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34089288/aa780d0a5ddfc7606882aabe82475f79b7c53b25.gif[/img]

[*] [b]Triggers[/b] - Connect triggers to any of the interactive objects, and it will send a signal anytime the action happens. Triggers include tripwires, buttons, levers and toggle switches.


[*] [b]Dynamic Park Pieces[/b] - Create moving platforms at 1, 2, or 4 times speed using the same placement system as our custom rail & ramp tools. Enablers, which can turn entire park pieces off and on.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34089288/50ef47820236b1c5fc4e1a5bf0b6cbec0cca03a2.gif[/img]

[*] [b]Particle Emitters[/b] - When activated, these will emit particles; we’ve given you a few of the in-game particles to select from

[*] [b]Speakers [/b]- Connect a speaker to any of the in-game buttons or triggers and have it play one of  the selected in-game sound effects

[*] [b]Pick ups[/b] - A selection of objects for you to place throughout your level,  When picked up, they output a signal.

[*] [b]Lights[/b] - Connect in-game objects to any in-game light and have it light up, or turn off (with the use of Logic Blocks)

[*] [b]Teleporters[/b] - Create two different locations, and teleport between them

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34089288/ba850a3db7f4961a54956a8b2bd5a11bdd5e463b.gif[/img]

[*][b] Custom Game Functions[/b]  - we’re excited about these ones…. These pieces are very specific in nature, one, when activated, will give the player that activates it points.  The other will end the round. 
[/list]


[h3]These features will release on PC Wednesday, September 15th. [/h3]


This developer preview gives a brief showcase of the new Signal Tools, as well as a small example wiring some triggers to lights!
[previewyoutube=QtGQ7CQ92Bg;full][previewyoutube=Y_luq8a3tEU;full][/previewyoutube][/previewyoutube]

That's all for now, we'll have more information on Team Based Gamemodes SOON™

-Kyle

This week we're heading to PAX West to showcase Wave Break, and we'll be hosting a large playtest throughout the entire weekend of PAX! You can get a key from the Discord channel, and play as much as you like throughout the duration of the playtest.

[u][b]PAX West Alpha Multiplayer Playtest[/b][/u]
August 30th, 10AM (PST) - September 2nd, 5PM (PST)

[*] Time Attack

Along with vastly improved water visuals and physics, you now get an extra combo multiplier when you kill another player. You can now freely jump in and out of your boat - or steal one from another player!

Thanks to the many helpful reports from our previous playtesters, we’ve been able to fix bugs and improve performance.  If you see something, say something!
